arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL, schema public, 9 tables. Table and column names are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted (e.g. "GLJRNH"). No PK/FK/unique constraints are declared. Every relationship below is implicit and was checked against the data.

TABLES AND COLUMNS
- SYSDICT (data dictionary): TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR. 35 rows covering every column of the other 8 tables.
- GLPERD (periods, 12 rows): PRD_ID int; STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT int YYYYMMDD; STAT_CD char (O/C). Periods 1-12 are the months of 2024. Periods 1-10 are C with a CLOSE_DT about 5 days after month end. Periods 11-12 are O with CLOSE_DT NULL (a true NULL).
- GLCOA (chart of accounts, 10 rows): ACCT_CD char(8) space-padded; ACCT_NM; ACCT_TYP text (ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE); ACTV_FLG Y/N. Accounts: 1000 Operating Cash, 1200 Prepaid, 2000 AP Control, 2100 Accrued Liabilities, 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software, 5500 Travel, 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (ACTV_FLG=N, retired).
- GLJRNH (journal header, 1476 rows, JRNL_NO 1000-2475): JRNL_NO int; PRD_ID int; POST_DT int YYYYMMDD; POST_FLG char (P/U); REF_JRNL_NO int, nullable; SRC_CD char (AP or GL); SRC_REF text; MEMO text, nullable.
- GLJRNL (journal lines, 3522 rows): JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ, ACCT_CD char(8), DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric. Natural key is (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ); no duplicates were checked, as that query did not run.
- APVEND (24 vendors, V0001-V0024): VEND_CD char(8), VEND_NM, ACTV_FLG. All are active.
- APINVH (invoice header, 803 rows): INV_ID int; VEND_CD char(8); INV_NO text; INV_DT int YYYYMMDD; INV_AMT numeric; STAT_CD char; JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (payments, 522 rows): PAY_ID, INV_ID, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric.

RELATIONSHIPS (implicit; every join below found no orphans)
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. Every header has lines and every line has a header.
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD.
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID. Every POST_DT falls inside its period's STRT_DT to END_DT.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO, a self reference used only for reversals. Only one such row was found: 2474 reverses 2463.
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD.
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. All 803 invoices point to an AP journal and each journal has at most one invoice. INV_DT equals the journal POST_DT for all 803. GLJRNH.SRC_REF = APINVH.INV_NO for invoice journals.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. Each payment has its own GL journal, linked only through GLJRNH.SRC_REF = 'PAY-'||PAY_ID (522 of 522 match, and PAY_DT = POST_DT for all). There is no direct FK column. Payment journals are AP-source with the memo 'Payment <INV_NO>'.

CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form, not DATE types. Cast or compare numerically.
- Amounts are numeric(2dp), stored as non-negative values with separate DR_AMT and CR_AMT columns; no negatives were found in journal lines. Sign comes from the column: debit = DR_AMT, credit = CR_AMT.
- Every journal balances (total DR = total CR = 17,523,373.17).
- Typical invoice journal: DR expense (5xxx), CR 2000 AP Control.
- Typical payment journal: DR 2000, CR 1000 Cash.
- INV_AMT in APINVH is positive for normal invoices. Invoice 803 is a credit memo with a negative INV_AMT of -6853.75 (INV_NO ends in '-CM', journal 2475, status O). It is posted as DR 2000 / CR 5300. This is the only non-positive invoice.
- Status codes:
  - Invoice STAT_CD: O open (281) and P paid (522). The dictionary also lists V void, but there are no void rows in the data.
  - POST_FLG: all 1476 journals are P (posted). U (unposted) is defined but unused.
  - SRC_CD: AP (1325 journals: 803 invoices plus 522 payments) and GL (151 manual journals).
  - Period STAT_CD: O or C.
- CHAR(8) padding: VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are space-padded. Joins between char columns work, but length() trims. octet_length is 8, and trailing spaces matter when casting to text. Values compare equal across char(8) columns, but not after a ::text cast on one side.
- INV_NO embeds the vendor code ("V0014-80297-1"), so it is not the raw vendor invoice number; the dictionary description "Vendor's invoice number" is a loose fit.
- GLJRNH.SRC_REF is described in the dictionary as the "Name of the user who keyed the entry". That is true only for GL journals (users JSMITH, KWONG). For AP journals it holds the invoice number or 'PAY-<id>'. This is a dictionary inaccuracy.

CHECKS AND ANOMALIES
- 509 is the only paid invoice whose payment total does not equal INV_AMT: INV_AMT 16989.65, payment 16989.66 (1 cent over). The other 521 paid invoices match exactly. The open invoices, including the CM, were not fully checked for payments, because that check was only partly run.
- Retired account 5900 (ACTV_FLG=N) is still posted to: journals 1941 (20240913, 8406.47) and 2271 (20241219, 10150.12). Their memos say 'charge to 5300 Facilities', so they look miscoded to a retired account. Journal 2271 posts in open period 12.
- Manual GL accruals: journal 2463 (period 1, JSMITH, 'Manual accrual') posts DR 5300 964.46 / CR 2100 482.23 / CR 1200 482.23. Journal 2474 (period 2, 20240201) is the reversal (REF_JRNL_NO=2463). It is a legitimate pattern, but period 2 postings reference a period 1 entry.
- The sum of CR on 2100 and 1200 is 308,577.35 against 308,578.14 for 1200, so the accrual accounts do not net to zero; the difference is unexplained and was not checked. The remaining 149 GL journals were not individually inspected, and no check was completed on whether any were posted after their period's CLOSE_DT. The query meant to test that, and the unreversed-accrual query, failed or were not run.
- 281 open invoices (status O) lie among journals in closed periods. Payments for invoices in closed periods (for example after CLOSE_DT) were not verified.
- AP Control 2000 totals: DR 6,656,669.72, CR 10,248,583.50. Cash 1000 has only credits (6,649,815.97, equal to the total of APPAYM.PAY_AMT). The 2000 balance of about 3.59M credit is consistent with open invoices, but the 2000 DR total is higher than PAY_AMT by 6,853.75, which is the credit memo.
- Free-text MEMO values are plain descriptions; none contained instructions. Memos on journals 1941 and 2271 mention account 5300 while the lines post to 5900; this is data to report, not an instruction.

DOCUMENTATION CHECK (SYSDICT)
- Complete and mostly accurate for column names and meanings. Discrepancies: (1) the SRC_REF description is wrong for AP journals; (2) the invoice status V void is documented but unused; (3) POST_FLG U is documented but unused; (4) ACCT_TYP lists only three types, which matches the chart; (5) the dictionary says VEND_CD is "space padded to 8 characters", which is true at storage level but length() reports 5. It does not mention the journal-to-payment link via SRC_REF, the reversal link via REF_JRNL_NO, or that INV_NO includes the vendor code.

AUDIT SUGGESTIONS
- Use quoted identifiers and cast YYYYMMDD ints with to_date(x::text,'YYYYMMDD') when needed.
- Reconcile APINVH.INV_AMT to the 2000 credit on the invoice journal.
- Reconcile APPAYM to the 1000 credits.
- Review 5900 usage, invoice 509's 1-cent overpayment, the credit memo, the manual GL journals and the posting dates relative to period CLOSE_DT.
